body.statement: Using the handle \(\mathfrak H_{\mathrm{exact}}\), determine whether \(\kappa_-=\kappa_+\), compute the common constant if it exists, and characterize all asymptotically extremal dual-tight obstruction geometries up to dummy-row padding, replication, and vanishing perturbations. If the limit fails to exist, determine the exact set of subsequential limits of \(N\Delta_N\).
body.justification: The order theorem leaves a nontrivial geometric extremal problem rather than presenting the loose universal constant as sharp.
body.gap: Neither empirical Monge counterexamples nor mixability approximation theory identifies the exact normalized same-marginal squared-cost loss or its extremizers.
body.consumer: An exact constant would replace the conservative universal width by a sharp planning and reporting benchmark at moderate trial sizes.
